phase5Decisions.decision: Agent-upload and seller-portal seller documents are audited against the same canonical seller audience plan.
Original acquisition records and capital-improvement/CGT records are not seller upload requests at this phase unless legal policy explicitly enables them later.
Professional-only seller policy requests remain visible to attorney workflows, not as seller portal upload prompts.
